questions.subject: ANALYTICAL_CHEMISTRY
questions.learningObjective: count significant figures in a decimal
questions.stem: Sample 0101: How many significant figures are in the measurement 0.0058397?

options.misconception: counts one of the leading zeros as significant
counts both the leading zeros and the trailing digit
fails to count the last significant digit

questions.explanation: Leading zeros only locate the decimal point and are never significant, while every nonzero digit is significant. Counting the leading zeros or dropping the final digit both misstate the number of significant figures in the measurement.
questions.hint: Zeros before the first nonzero digit do not count.

questions.learningObjective: round a product to a requested decimal place

questions.explanation: The exact product is rounded once to the requested decimal place. Shifting the decimal point or adding an arbitrary amount does not round the product and would misreport the result of the multiplication.
questions.hint: Round the exact product to one decimal place.
